title: 1.2 What people do
unit_outcome: Describe people and family, say what people do every day and how often, and ask about other people's habits in Spanish.
goal: Say what people do: Tomo café. Luis toma café. Ana lee libros.
grammar_function: Present tense yo and él/ella: tomo/toma, leo/lee, como/come, escribe; ¿Quién…?
speaking_outcome: Say what people do: Tomo café. Luis toma café. Ana lee libros.
